claims: The Artemis II crew consists of four astronauts.
The Artemis II crew is scheduled for a 10-day mission around the Moon.
Reid Wiseman (NASA) is the Commander of the Artemis II crew.
Victor Glover (NASA) is the Pilot of the Artemis II crew.
Christina Koch (NASA) is a Mission Specialist of the Artemis II crew.
Jeremy Hansen (Canadian Space Agency) is a Mission Specialist of the Artemis II crew.
Artemis II will be the first crewed flight to the Moon in over 50 years.
Artemis II is Reid Wiseman's second spaceflight.
Victor Glover will be the first person of color to go to the Moon.
Christina Koch is a veteran astronaut.
Christina Koch will be the first woman to go to the Moon.
Jeremy Hansen represents the Canadian Space Agency.
Jeremy Hansen will be the first Canadian to go to the Moon.
The Artemis II crew is testing the Orion spacecraft.
The Artemis II crew has dubbed the Orion spacecraft "Integrity".
